names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 26 Ιουλίου, «Όσιος Ιγνάτιος ο Στειρωνίτης», with the rank word and the byname left off. The page glosses the name from γηγενής, the earth-born, the native.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 26ης Ιουλίου — «Όσιος Ιγνάτιος ο Στειρωνίτης»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 26 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. He is none of the corpus's many men of the name — of Antioch, of Constantinople, of Rostov, of Mariupol, of Methymna, of Stara Zagora, of Bathys Ryax, the Sinaite, Brianchaninov, Biryukov, the bare one of 19 May and the two monk-martyrs of 1938 and 1942: none of them is kept on 26 July and none carries the byname Στειρωνίτης. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence; the page gives no year, no place and no life beyond one sentence, and prints no hymn. Under the name gloss it carries the words «Βυζαντινός συγγραφέας», a Byzantine writer, which belongs to its dictionary note on the name and not to this saint, and nothing is taken from it.
